meta.name: repo
meta.description: Convention + tooling for where agent-cloned repos live. Default `~/.x-repo/<provider>/<owner>/<name>`, discovered via `x repo ls`. Use for "where to clone", "git clone path", "workspace layout", "shared repos between agents".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 agent 克隆仓库的存放位置与发现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个 agent 间共享仓库并统一克隆路径。
copy.tagline_en: Manage where agent-cloned repos live and discover them
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need shared repos between agents and a consistent clone path.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照统一规则存放克隆的代码仓库，默认放在 ~/.x-repo/ 目录下，并优先复用已有克隆，避免重复下载。
howto.when: 当用户要求克隆代码仓库、询问仓库存放位置或需要管理多个仓库时触发。

say.text: 把这个仓库克隆到默认位置。
say.note: Claude 会按规则克隆到 ~/.x-repo/ 下。

say.text: 列出所有已克隆的仓库。
say.note: Claude 会运行 x repo ls 显示列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude stores cloned repos under ~/.x-repo/<provider>/<owner>/<name> by default, reuses existing clones, and avoids duplicate downloads.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to clone a repo, asks about repo storage location, or needs to manage multiple repos.

say_en.text: Clone this repo to the default location.

say_en.note: Claude runs x repo ls to show the list.
Claude will use the new root directory.
